parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal plywood shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of plywood, part of the internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary or can be repositioned if adjustable.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf located in the mid-lower section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports heavier items and contributes to the cabinet’s internal organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Shelf 4
parts.Basic_description: A lower shelf made of plywood, part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides support for stored items near the bottom of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 5
parts.Basic_description: The topmost internal shelf of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports lightweight items and helps organize the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not designed for movement during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 1
parts.Basic_description: A front door panel made of MDF, located on the lower section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the contents of the cabinet, providing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 2
parts.Basic_description: A second lower door panel made of MDF, paired with the first to enclose the lower compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage area and protects stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 3
parts.Basic_description: An upper cabinet door made of MDF, part of the top storage section.
parts.Functional_description: It conceals and protects items in the upper compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates on hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 4
parts.Basic_description: A second upper cabinet door made of MDF, paired with the third door to enclose the top section.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the upper storage area and maintains a clean exterior appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.
